categories.title: Coding Harnesses
categories.summary: Interactive coding agent harnesses spanning terminals, desktop apps, and IDE extensions.

categories.title: Agent Multiplexers & Control Planes
categories.summary: Control planes, multiplexers, and overlays that coordinate multiple coding agent sessions or host harnesses in parallel.

categories.title: Autonomous & Sandbox-First Harnesses
categories.summary: End-to-end engineering runtimes built around containerized execution and long-horizon autonomous loops.

categories.title: Personal & Browser Harnesses
categories.summary: Always-on local runtimes and browser-execution harnesses connecting models to messaging channels, operating systems, or live web pages.

categories.title: Harness SDKs
categories.summary: Code-first SDKs exposing a complete agent harness runtime (execution loop, tools, sandboxing, and session management).

harnesses.name: Aider
harnesses.description: Git-native Python terminal pair programmer with repository mapping, clean multi-file diffs, and automatic commits.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.description: Anthropic's coding harness across terminal, IDE extensions, Chrome extension, and official mobile Remote Control with worktrees and hooks.

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.description: OpenAI's Rust coding harness across CLI, IDE extensions, desktop, cloud, and mobile-paired remote control with OS sandboxing and automations.

harnesses.name: Crush
harnesses.description: Multi-model Go terminal coding harness by Charmbracelet with LSP-aware edits and MCP support.

harnesses.name: Antigravity
harnesses.description: Google's agentic development harness across CLI (`agy`), desktop app, and IDE with a built-in browser agent, sandboxing, and parallel swarms.

harnesses.name: Goose
harnesses.description: Single-binary Rust agent harness with native MCP extensions, named sessions, and repeatable headless recipes.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.description: xAI's open-source Rust coding harness with mouse-interactive TUI, headless CI mode, ACP editor integration, worktree subagents, MCP, and LSP.

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.description: Open-source terminal, desktop, and self-hosted web/mobile coding harness supporting 75+ model providers and LSP.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.description: Minimalist TypeScript terminal harness built around four core tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`) and 25+ lifecycle hooks.

harnesses.name: Plandex
harnesses.description: Terminal coding harness designed for large multi-file tasks using structured planning and reviewable diff sandboxes.

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.description: Open-source VS Code agent harness with Plan/Act modes, shadow-git checkpoints, built-in browser control, and MCP.

harnesses.name: Continue
harnesses.description: Open-source IDE coding assistant and agent extension for VS Code and JetBrains supporting bring-your-own models.

harnesses.name: Kilo Code
harnesses.description: Open-source, model-agnostic coding agent spanning VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, and cloud surfaces.

harnesses.name: Roo Code
harnesses.description: Extensible IDE agent harness derived from Cline featuring customizable agent modes, browser control, and terminal execution.

harnesses.name: better-harness
harnesses.description: Open-source harness engineering toolkit for defining harnesses as code, running controlled experiments, and comparing outcomes.

harnesses.name: cmux
harnesses.description: Ghostty-based native terminal multiplexer for AI coding agents with agent-aware notifications, an in-app scriptable split browser, and a companion mobile app.

harnesses.name: Harness²
harnesses.description: Google Research framework exploring recursive agent harnessing via propose-probe-compose loops in open-world tasks.

harnesses.name: Herdr
harnesses.description: Rust terminal multiplexer and persistent daemon for coding agents with semantic state tracking (working/blocked/done), multi-machine SSH orchestration, and socket API.

harnesses.name: oh-my-openagent
harnesses.description: Multi-agent orchestration overlay for OpenCode adding parallel subagents, background tasks, and persistent execution modes.

harnesses.name: OpenHarness
harnesses.description: Open-source command center and multiplexer for running parallel coding agent sessions with persistent contexts and messaging.

harnesses.name: T3 Code
harnesses.description: Unified desktop, web, and mobile multiplexer for controlling local Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode sessions over worktrees.

harnesses.name: Trellis
harnesses.description: Structured agent harness overlay emphasizing versioned specs, skill recording, and coherent multi-platform workspaces.

harnesses.name: Grok Bot
harnesses.description: xAI's autonomous teammate platform giving each persistent agent its own cloud VM sandbox, terminal, browser/computer use, and multi-bot orchestration.

harnesses.name: OpenHands
harnesses.description: Open-source autonomous software engineering platform (formerly OpenDevin) with containerized sandboxes, LiteLLM routing, and ACP.

harnesses.name: SWE-agent
harnesses.description: Research-to-production autonomous harness introducing purpose-built Agent-Computer Interfaces for resolving GitHub issues.

harnesses.name: TrueForge
harnesses.description: Open-source agent harness managing model loops, MCP tools, skills, sandboxed execution, and approvals via UI, API, and SDK.

harnesses.name: Browser Use
harnesses.description: Open-source web automation harness enabling LLM agents to navigate, click, fill forms, and drive local or headless browsers.

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.description: Python autonomous agent daemon by Nous Research featuring cross-session memory, messaging channels, and self-authored skills.

harnesses.name: OpenClaw
harnesses.description: Self-hosted, pluggable TypeScript personal agent gateway connecting local automations and browser control to 20+ messaging apps.

harnesses.name: Antigravity SDK (Python)
harnesses.description: Official Python SDK for programmatic agent leasing, orchestration, and custom tools on Google Antigravity.

harnesses.name: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
harnesses.description: Official Python SDK exposing Claude Code's agent loop, local tooling, permissions, and in-process MCP integration.

harnesses.name: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
harnesses.description: Official TypeScript SDK for programmatically embedding and customizing Claude's agent harness.

harnesses.name: Deep Agents
harnesses.description: Batteries-included open-source Python agent harness and CLI from LangChain with task planning, filesystem memory, and subagents.

harnesses.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
harnesses.description: Lightweight Python SDK for agent loops, multi-agent handoffs, guardrails, sessions, and execution tracing.

harnesses.name: Strands Agents Harness SDK
harnesses.description: Open-source Python/TypeScript harness SDK providing policy-enforced sandboxing, built-in tools, and evaluation hooks.
